question.text: What will the Ibovespa close at on 26 November 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the closing level of the Ibovespa (B3's benchmark index, ticker ^BVSP) for the trading session of Thursday, 26 November 2026, in index points, taken from the 'Close' column of the row dated Nov 26, 2026 in the Yahoo Finance historical prices table at https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/%5EBVSP/history/ (use 'Close', not 'Adj Close'). Values are entered in index points, e.g. a reported close of 173,845.55 points is entered as 173845.55. If that table does not yet show the 26 November 2026 value when checked, resolution waits until it does. If the Yahoo Finance page is unavailable or has no row for that session, the closing level reported for that date by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) will be used.
question.fine_print: A shortened session, trading halt or circuit breaker on 26 November 2026 does not affect resolution; the closing value reported for that session is used as described above.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-13: Yahoo Finance's chart API for ^BVSP, which feeds the history table, shows the last close as **172,457.77** (+0.66% on the day). The run of daily closes is: 23 Oct 205,083; 26 Oct 176,608; 27 Oct 175,710; 28 Oct 171,006; 29 Oct 169,186; 30 Oct 167,922; 3 Nov 165,529; 4 Nov 167,564; 5 Nov 166,192; 6 Nov 168,499; 9 Nov 172,236; 10 Nov 171,337; 11 Nov 172,060; 12 Nov 171,324; 13 Nov 172,458. The 52-week high is 209,714. [Yahoo chart API](https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/%5EBVSP?range=1mo&interval=1d)
- **Discrepancy:** the question background gives the 13 Nov close as 172,013.72. Yahoo and Money Times both show 172,457.76/77, so the background figure looks wrong.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. Eight sessions remain (16-26 Nov, skipping the 20 Nov holiday). The index is about 16% below its pre-runoff level, about 4% above the 3 Nov low (165,529), and inside the question range (150k-195k).

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-14: Week of 9-13 Nov: Ibovespa +2.35% to 172,457.76, dollar +2.66% to R$5.655. Other items:
  - Selic held at 13.75%. The Copom minutes say the economy is slowing fast, but inflation expectations call for high rates for longer.
  - October IPCA was +0.14%, above expectations.
  - Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid a scandal, and US tech stocks fell.
  - US CPI came in hot. CME FedWatch reportedly priced an 85.5% chance of a Fed hike to 4.00-4.25%.
  - Movers: Banco do Brasil -11.85% on a weak quarter, CSN -15.65%, Magazine Luiza +39%. [Money Times](https://www.moneytimes.com.br/magazine-luiza-mglu3-lidera-ganhos-com-alta-de-mais-de-39-enquanto-csn-csna3-e-a-pior-acao-da-semana-veja-o-que-rolou-no-ibovespa-davs/)
- 2026-11-14: Domestic-focused indices (small caps, real estate, consumer) are down 12-14% in 2026, while the Ibovespa is up about 7% year to date. [Circuito MT](https://circuitomt.com.br/indices-de-consumo-imoveis-e-small-caps-tombam-ate-14-em-2026-e-mercado-cobra-sinalizacao-fiscal-de-lula/)
- 2026-11-13: The Ibovespa returned to 172k after the Senate approved the fiscal package, helped by retail sales that beat expectations. Analysts remain sceptical: they call the package insufficient and question whether the measures are permanent and big enough to stabilise the debt. [NC News](https://ncnews.com.br/2026/11/13/ibovespa-volta-aos-172-mil-pontos-apos-aprovacao-de-ajuste-fiscal-no-senado/), [InvestNews](https://investnews.com.br/investimentos/ibovespa-pacote-fiscal-nao-anima/), [SpaceMoney](https://www.spacemoney.com.br/investimentos/mercado-ve-ajuste-fiscal-insuficiente)
- 2026-11-12: The Senate approved the base text of PLP 299/2026 by 45-31, with an estimated 2027 primary-balance gain of R$45.1-56.1bn. Votes on separate amendments ("destaques") are set for 17 Nov, after which the bill goes to the Chamber. I found no Chamber schedule. [BPMoney](https://bpmoney.com.br/economia/ibovespa-sobe-aos-1715-mil-pontos-apos-aprovacao-de-ajuste-fiscal-b3-cai/)

## 4. Base rates
- Code-computed baseline (9-session returns over the last 3 years, from 172,458): p5 163.8k, p10 165.8k, p25 169.6k, p50 173.3k, p75 177.1k, p90 181.2k, p95 184.8k. This probably understates volatility now: since the runoff, daily moves have often been 1-2%, including a -13.88% day.
- Since 9 Nov the index has traded in a narrow 171.3k-172.5k band at the close. Between 23 Oct and 3 Nov it fell from 205k to 165.5k.
- Same window in past years (Yahoo closes):
  - 2025: 14 Nov 157,739 to 26 Nov 158,555 (+0.5%), with a dip to 154,770 on 21 Nov in between. [Yahoo](https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/%5EBVSP?period1=1762992000&period2=1764288000&interval=1d)
  - 2024: 14 Nov 127,792 to 26 Nov 129,922 (+1.7%). [Yahoo](https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/%5EBVSP?period1=1731456000&period2=1732752000&interval=1d)
  - 2023: 14 Nov 123,328 to 24 Nov 125,542 (+1.8%; 26 Nov was a Sunday). [Yahoo](https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/%5EBVSP?period1=1699833600&period2=1701129600&interval=1d)
- So the last three years all rose modestly over this window, but there is no strong seasonal pattern. This year the level is depressed by the election shock rather than following a seasonal trend.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Kalshi "How high will the IBOVESPA get this year? (2026)": "at least 210,000" at 44%, 215,000 at 11%, 220,000 at 5%. These prices show the market sees only a small chance of a return to pre-election highs by year end, but they do not price a 26 Nov level directly. The 99% prices at lower strikes are thresholds the index has already hit.
- Polymarket on Brazil's central bank decision in March 2027: no change 57%, 25 bp hike 17%, 50+ bp hike 14.5%, which leans hawkish. Polymarket "election annulled by 31 Dec": 1.4%.
- I could not find any market or analyst forecast for the Ibovespa level on a specific date in late November.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-17: Senate votes on the PLP 299 amendments. After that the bill goes to the Chamber, and timing there is a key domestic risk. [SpaceMoney](https://www.spacemoney.com.br/investimentos/acoes/ibovespa-hoje/ibovespa-futuro-ajuste-fiscal-senado-galipolo)
- Week of 16-20 Nov: Money Times flags "GDP preview and Fed minutes" as the week's highlights. The GDP preview is likely the IBC-Br and the Fed minutes likely the FOMC minutes, but I could not confirm the dates.
- 2026-11-20: B3 holiday (Black Consciousness Day).
- Probably the week of 23 Nov: Brazil's mid-month inflation reading (IPCA-15). Not confirmed.
- Ongoing: US rate repricing after the hot CPI, fallout from the Nvidia leadership scandal, and the USD/BRL rate (R$5.65, the weakest since June 2025).
- 2026-11-26: US markets are closed for Thanksgiving, so liquidity will be thin. The B3 session runs normally.
- After resolution: Copom decision on 9 Dec.
